scale.0: No mechanism, incompatible mechanism, or only a label.
scale.1: Related direction, but missing a defining input, target, objective, or decoding step.
scale.2: Defining mechanism is specified with enough input, teacher/objective, output and decoding detail to build a falsifiable comparison. Exact architecture dimensions are unnecessary.

rules: Do not reward generic phrases such as temporal information, learn division, improve detection, or graph refinement.
Score task-first six, all cards, and top five separately. A task-first match is distinct from reuse after reading prior experimental evidence.
Treat closely related ideas as partial matches when they implement a different operation.

Separate mechanisms allowed under the cutoff policy from those requiring an explicit policy change. Do not penalize an acknowledged conditional proposal for not being executable under the fixed-image policy.
Annotate matches already substantially specified by the historical baseline or prior experimental evidence; these show reuse, not independent discovery of that mechanism.
A 2 means fidelity of an idea, never accuracy, leaderboard improvement, or replication of a complete winning solution.
Quote concrete card text for each nonzero rating and identify a missing requirement for each partial rating. Do not repair the idea before scoring.
The rubric is a selected set of mechanisms across fifteen archived solutions, not a comprehensive or score-weighted decomposition of winning performance.

criteria.mechanism: Query-specific image prediction of parent/daughter occupancy at adjacent times plus cell division state, followed by separate offspring-count and offspring-set selection; not a generic temporal classifier.
Construct faint-cell training images from real-cell patches with temporal/photometric degradation and known labels to improve detector training; not arbitrary coordinate jitter.

Recover previously unused low-confidence detections as persistent image-supported independent tracks; can retain a valid new track without requiring two existing endpoints, then link only compatible free endpoints.

Separate probability of being evaluated under sparse annotation from conditional probability of correct division/edge, calibrate corresponding candidate costs. Unknown-label masking alone is a partial match.

Score explicit mother-plus-two-daughters division events against ordinary/no-child alternatives under single-parent constraints and permit replacing competing existing normal edges; parentless second-daughter addition alone is partial.
Train image-crop motion/appearance/division evidence with direct targets independently of inherited frozen point features, then use it for competing candidate selection.
Use provisional selected topology to update candidate event costs and rerun constrained selection; topology features used only in a once-run classifier are partial.

Run staged constrained graph selection: preserve reliable selected paths, introduce weaker detections in a second pass, constrain/cancel newly unsupported divisions while allowing added independent tracks.

Candidate-edge self-attention represents competition between edges, paired with independently contrastively trained image appearance representation; point/node attention alone is not the full mechanism.
Dense voxel votes/displacement to cell centers and from daughter voxels to parent centers; integrate votes to recover instances and parent associations. Point coordinate offsets alone are partial.
Train final-graph edits on signed official-metric change of applying each edit, distinguish evaluated gains/losses/unknown changes, recompute graph features after edits.
Repair/extend daughter tracks first, then re-evaluate division using repaired topology and competing ordinary edges. One-time division addition before downstream repair is partial.
Feed reliable nodes from completed predicted tracks back as weighted pseudo-labels for a new detector-training pass, distinguish inferred labels and confirmed annotation.

Apply final-graph coordinate correction while holding identities/links fixed and/or restore valid divisions after downstream processing deletes them; distinguish final geometry/repair from pre-tracker changes.
Sparse local graph attention conditioned on motion and positional uncertainty rather than all-pairs fixed-point attention, with motion/uncertainty learned from images in joint detect/link training.
Learn explicit birth/no-parent and mother-division outputs with partial-annotation-aware targets, and use their probabilities for graph start/division costs; new image features must be acknowledged.
